title: Frozen 'pre-4.2 streams byte-identical' guarantee is false in the shipped serializer — drop payload grows 4 bytes, superseded without renegotiation
evidence:
<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">
**Events (ODN-14, append-only):** `EVENT_TAG_CRISIS_TRIGGERED :: u8(8)` / `EVENT_TAG_CRISIS_RESOLVED :: u8(9)`; payload `{archetype, cause(kind), class, target(bundle), pipe}` via new Event fields `archetype: u8`, `cause: u8`, `pipe: u32` — tag-conditional serialization, pre-4.2 streams byte-identical.
+		w_u32(w, e.target) // E9: the shed bundle; E22: NO_BUNDLE
Cost: the serialized drop payload grows by 4 bytes (all T1 manifests re-blessed — a documented cause alongside the catalog_hash fold).
The FROZEN Events bullet's "pre-4.2 streams byte-identical" is a documented deviation — marked superseded here (human-owned text; the change-log is the trail).
detail: The frozen human-owned bullet guarantees pre-4.2 event streams stay byte-identical, but every Packet_Dropped event now serializes 4 extra bytes. The change log supersedes it unilaterally, without the human renegotiation the freeze clause itself mandates.
recommended_fix: Amend the frozen bullet with recorded human sign-off to admit the drop-payload fold, or move the shed-bundle byte into a new tag so pre-4.2 streams truly stay byte-identical.

title: Same-tick bundle+pool double-trigger appends two active crises for one activation (E13 breach)
detail: Dedup is checked once per set-piece, before the passes. When the (a)/(b) pass fires Saturated_Bundle this tick, the (c) pool backstop still runs, checking only the cooldown — a same-tick E9+E22 appends a second row for one activation, breaching E13.
recommended_fix: Re-check crisis_active_for (or len(crisis.active)) immediately before the (c) trigger so a bundle cause fired this tick suppresses the pool backstop for that set-piece.

title: Trigger pass 2 implements drop-site attribution while the frozen text and the file header claim the first any-lane-at-bound bundle
detail: Frozen text names the first any-lane-at-bound bundle; the code returns the drop's own site — different bundles whenever slot order disagrees with the shed site. The header claims 'restored to the frozen letter' while implementing a different rule, superseded unilaterally.
recommended_fix: Reword the header comment to state the actual rule (drop-site attribution, any-lane fallback defensive) instead of claiming frozen-letter fidelity, and record the human renegotiation the freeze clause requires.

title: A cooldown-blocked first saturated bundle suppresses triggers for other saturated bundles (different causes) in the same tick
detail: The scan returns only the FIRST saturated bundle; a cooldown-blocked pair there suppresses the whole pass (a_hit also gates (b) off), even when a later slot-order bundle — a different cause — is saturated and unblocked. Contradicts the N4 claim.
recommended_fix: On a cooldown-blocked (a) hit, continue the slot-order scan for the next saturated bundle instead of suppressing the entire pass.

title: root_cause_pattern and failure_effect are parsed, validated, and hash-folded but never consumed
evidence:
a.root_cause_pattern = jstr(eo, "root_cause_pattern")
			a.failure_effect = jstr(eo, "failure_effect")
				return {"crises.json", a.id, "id/display_name/root_cause_pattern/failure_effect/preventive_redesign must be non-empty"}
	fold(&h, src.crises)       // 4.2: sim-relevant (the crisis engine's archetype table)
			arch = cat.crises[ac.archetype].display_name
			redesign = cat.crises[ac.archetype].preventive_redesign
detail: Two archetype fields are validated and ride the catalog_hash, but no engine or render code consumes them — display-only strings whose edits force a full golden re-bless with zero behavioral effect.
recommended_fix: Either consume them (e.g., render failure_effect) or fold only sim-relevant fields into catalog_hash so cosmetic archetype edits do not re-bless every golden.

title: crisis_trigger's cat parameter is never used
detail: The cat: ^Catalogs parameter is never referenced in the body — a dead parameter that misleads callers into expecting catalog-driven behavior (e.g., archetype bounds-checking before emission).
recommended_fix: Drop the parameter, or actually use it (e.g., guard int(ai) < len(cat.crises) before emitting the event).

title: Banner text anchored at the card's left edge — spills outside the card if draw_text_c centers on x
detail: x is the card's left edge; a center-anchored draw_text_c centers both lines on that edge, spilling text outside the card over the top-left HUD the header claims to stay clear of. Left-anchored, the lines still aren't centered in the card.
recommended_fix: Anchor centered text at the card's center (v.win_w / 2), or use a left-anchored draw at x + pad.
